title: Completed tower pushforward is acyclic for the target inverse limit
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ a finite extension and $f:X\to Y$ a scheme morphism. Use the completed coefficient ring sheaves and module categories of [def-pur-completed-pushforward-models], with independent site and coefficient universes. Let $c:R_Y\to f_*R_X$ be any ring-sheaf structural map, and let L be any supplied SiteLimitData on Y. If I is a K-injective cochain complex of strict inverse sequences of R_X-modules, the unit of L.limit at the levelwise pushforward of I is an isomorphism. Equivalently that pushed tower computes the given total derived inverse limit. No quotient structural compatibility, coefficient comparisons, strict coefficient systems or comparison of derived composites is assumed or concluded.

source.place: Tag 0D6E, lemma-derived-pushforward-composition (line 4011); Tag 0A07, lemma-Rf-commutes-with-Rlim (line 5150), first proof

proof.text: Choose a K-injective resolution of the levelwise pushforward complex using the completed-tower resolution input.
Apply the completed tower inverse-limit acyclicity input to the quasi-isomorphism from the pushed complex to its K-injective resolution.

Use naturality of target.limit.unit along the resolution map. Its component at the K-injective target is invertible by target.limit.computes; the inverse-limit image of the resolution map is invertible by the acyclicity input. Cancel this invertible composite to obtain the desired component.

lean.statement:
theorem towerLimit_push_acyclic {X Y : Scheme.{t}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (c : R l E Y ⟶ (ringPush.{t, u} f).obj (R l E X))
    (target : SiteLimitData l E Y)
    (I : CochainComplex (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ Mod X (R l E X)) ℤ) (hI : I.IsKInjective) :
    IsIso (target.limit.unit.app
      ((((Functor.whiskeringRight ℕᵒᵖ _ _).obj (push f c)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj I))
